title: Smiling Young Boy Riding Tricycle Outdoors, 1953 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Oct 1953

Bob selected the shoes.

as you can see Bob

H60
description: A charming snapshot from October 1953 capturing a young boy named Bob happily pedaling a three-wheeled tricycle along a driveway. He wears a warm buttoned knit cardigan, dark trousers, a cap, and sturdy lace-up shoes which he picked out himself according to the handwritten note on the reverse. In the background stands a low, rustic single-story structure surrounded by trees, capturing the nostalgic innocence of 1950s postwar American childhood and outdoor playtime.
